opportunities.name: United.com flight search
opportunities.description: Search United flights from {origin} to {destination} for {dates}, trip type {roundtrip/one-way}, {travelers}, {cabin}, optionally with miles, and review the fare grid.
steps: Open united.com Book > Flight tab
Select Roundtrip or One-way; toggle Book with miles if needed
Type origin in From and pick the airport suggestion
Type destination in To and pick the airport suggestion
Open Dates calendar, navigate months and pick depart (and return) dates
Set travelers (adults/children) and cabin class if needed
Click Find flights
Review results / select fare or open details

opportunities.name: Tripadvisor restaurant search with filter
opportunities.description: Find restaurants in {location} on Tripadvisor and apply a {filter} (cuisine/dietary/feature) to narrow the list.
steps: Open Tripadvisor home and click Restaurants
Click the Where to? search box
Type the location and pick it from suggestions
On the restaurants page open the filter section (Show more if needed)
Check the desired filter (cuisine, dietary restriction or feature) and Apply
Review the filtered restaurants

instances.values: Central Park New York, Cuisine: Italian
Big Sur CA, Feature: Outdoor Seating

opportunities.name: SpotHero event parking search
opportunities.description: Find parking on SpotHero for {event} at {venue}, optionally with a filter (wheelchair accessible) and an adjusted entry/exit time.
steps: Open SpotHero home and type the venue in the search box
Pick the venue address suggestion
In the venue events modal, optionally pick the event date and select the event
Optionally click Filter, check Wheelchair Accessible and Show results
Optionally edit Enter After / Exit Before times and click Update Search
Review listings / click Book Now

instances.values: Barclays Center, Orlando Magic at Brooklyn Nets Apr 7, times 3:00-5:00 PM, Book Now
Busch Stadium, Pirates at Cardinals Apr 13, Wheelchair Accessible filter

opportunities.name: United Explore destinations map search
opportunities.description: Use United's map search to find destinations from {origin} with flexible dates and a max price.
steps: Open BOOK menu > Map search (Explore destinations)
Type origin in Flying from and choose the airport
Set Roundtrip and Dates (flexible dates) and max price
Click Search
Review the List of search results

instances.values: From Las Vegas LAS, roundtrip, flexible dates, $2000

opportunities.description: Open a restaurant from Tripadvisor results and save it to a newly created Trip named {trip_name}.
steps: Open restaurant page
Click Save
Click Create a Trip
Enter trip name, choose privacy
Click Create
